mapper.sql: id, category, code, name, description, site_message_enabled, sms_enabled, site_message_title, site_message_content, sms_template_id, sms_variable_mappings::text AS sms_variable_mappings_json, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message_notification WHERE category = #{category} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_notification ( category, code, name, description, site_message_enabled, sms_enabled, site_message_title, site_message_content, sms_template_id, sms_variable_mappings ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{siteMessageEnabled}, #{smsEnabled}, #{siteMessageTitle}, #{siteMessageContent}, #{smsTemplateId}, CAST(#{smsVariableMappingsJson} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE message_notification SET site_message_enabled = #{siteMessageEnabled}, sms_enabled = #{smsEnabled}, site_message_title = #{siteMessageTitle}, site_message_content = #{siteMessageContent}, sms_template_id = #{smsTemplateId}, sms_variable_mappings = CAST(#{smsVariableMappingsJson} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_notification WHERE sms_enabled = TRUE AND sms_template_id = #{templateId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message_notification notification JOIN sms_template template ON template.id = notification.sms_template_id WHERE notification.sms_enabled = TRUE AND template.provider <> #{provider}
